text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Is it over...? Did I...――

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer...! Did I... run properly—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"She's pushed to her limit. So fresh and 
green. She's trying so hard, you can't 
help but root for her~!" "Should we go 
watch the Winning Live too?"
choice_data_list: (Yeah, isn't that a great feeling?)
(Yeah, isn't that a great feeling?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Should we say that our challenges
have 
come to light?"
choice_data_list: (Yeah, feels pretty good, don't yo...
(Yeah, feels pretty good, right?)

text_block_list.text:
However, back in the waiting room, Royce 
and Royce was lost in thought with a 
troubled look.
choice_data_list: Both the results and the crowd's r...
Both the results and the crowd's r...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
They were certainly favorable, yes. But 
you see—
choice_data_list: The results and the crowd's reacti...
Both the results and the crowd's r...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Do you remember what everyone was saying?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"『Fresh』, 『earnest』... There wasn't a 
single comment about her actual running."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...It made me realize once again that my 
running lacks a decisive factor...
choice_data_list: That is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It is fine, there is no need for your 
concern. I am fully aware of it.
choice_data_list: That's...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Once people see such talented running
from 
Hayahide-san and the others, any 
impression I make will surely be blown 
away in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The impact of a powerful run is just that 
overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why, if I want people to 
think I'm the "strongest," I've got to 
work hard on my self-branding!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In the Junior Class,
fans haven't formed a 
solid impression of the Umamusume yet, so 
their opinions change easily.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
While I still have the chance, I need to 
firmly make my impression and pull ahead 
of the competition!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And create a dedicated fanbase!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Once they become dedicated fans, they 
won't leave you so easily!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And so, I want to focus on self-producing 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure we have enough time for that, 
could we focus primarily on training 
rather than entering races?"
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but I'd like to set ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In that case, entering the Classic Triple 
Crown races in your Classic year—the 
Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and the Kikuka Sho!
choice_data_list: I don't mind, but I'd like to set ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With massive attention from both the
media 
and fans, the Classic Triple Crown is the 
ultimate stage to make an impression.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I want to push some self-producing here.

The Classic Triple Crown races are
steeped in history and tradition.
An Umamusume who 
triumphs there will surely engrave her 
name into the memories of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So for both training and gaining fans, I 
want to aim squarely for the Classic 
Triple Crown!
choice_data_list: That's the basic plan. We'll adjus...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. We'll enter races as good 
opportunities arise. I'll leave the 
decisions to you, Trainer! For the time 
being, let's devote ourselves to 
self-producing!
choice_data_list: Let's stick to that main plan. We ...

text_block_list.text:
On her rest day the following day, she 
immediately sprung into action to win
over 
dedicated fans.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hardcore fan acquisition strategy, Step 
One! We're gonna film a video of us
making 
cheering fans!
choice_data_list: A handheld fan? ...W-Why?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
have you ever made an uchiwa fan? 
It actually takes a tremendous amount of 
effort, you know.
choice_data_list: A fan? ...W-Why?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By making it myself and experiencing the 
effort and care that goes into it, I can 
truly appreciate everyone. And express my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it feel great when someone 
recognizes your hard work and dedication? 
Praising someone's efforts is actually 
quite effective, you know.
choice_data_list: True...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it's true that they went through 
the trouble for me. So I want to return 
the favor.
choice_data_list: True...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Royce and Royce has finally made 
her debut~~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And you know, seeing that handmade fan at 
yesterday's Winning Live made me sooooo 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I decided to make a cheering 
fan too! I'm going to cheer for my friend 
Ikuno next time, so I plan to use it 
there♪"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... This sticker sheet is 
surprisingly tough to cut...
choice_data_list: Are you feeling a bit prickly?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It won't cut through in one go... The 
craft blade keeps slipping, this is so 
difficult...!
choice_data_list: Aren't you a bit on edge?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'll try doing it more slowly and 
carefully... I want to show off a truly 
beautiful fan, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Phew, finished! Now if I just stick this 
on the fan—
choice_data_list: Wouldn't it stand out more with a ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: A border...?
choice_data_list: Wouldn't it stand out more with a ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're right! It's outlined two, three 
times over...! I see,
so that it's easy to 
read even from far away...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'll make some too! The borders!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I-It's... finished! Woohoo~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... I had no idea making 
paper fans was this tough.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Our fans put so much time and effort into 
making these, too...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thinking up the message with all my
heart, 
agonizing over the color scheme, cutting 
out the letters over and over...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will take everyone's feelings to heart 
and carry them with me...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This hand fan... I hope Ikuno-san likes 
it...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah,
I'm beat! Making those uchiwa fans 
was seriously tough work!
choice_data_list: Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well? Could you feel what I was talking 
about?
choice_data_list: Good work.

text_block_list.text:
True, the fan who made the fan must be 
thrilled. But whether watching this video 
will turn someone into a core fan of hers 
is...
choice_data_list: Isn't it a bit weak to make people...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, quite sharp of you. That's right,
this 
is just a work in progress.
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too weak to make ...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's just the 'hop' in 'hop, step, jump,' 
after all.
choice_data_list: What about the steps and jumps?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The step is for when they use the fans. 
During my Winning Live.
choice_data_list: What about the steps and jumps?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Could I have that memo 
where you noted down the traits of my
fans 
during my debut race?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I use this during the steps.
I'll check it 
when I get home♪

Over the weekend, I was there with Royce 
and Royce and her friends to cheer on 
Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san, Nature-san. You both came... 
Thank you so much.

That is Ikuno Dictus, an Umamusume who 
exudes the aura of a capable secretary.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Impressive, you're totally calm. Guess 
that's what comes from being used to the 
big stage.

Nice Nature, a realistic and cynical 
Umamusume. It seems the two are close 
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just a little nervous. Everyone 
has placed so much expectation on me, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay! After all, Ikuno-san, you've 
run in more races than anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
When push comes to shove, I think her 
courage is second to none!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I'll trust in the path 
I've run. Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno's been having a rough year, 
struggling to close out her wins.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I finally won my last race,
but I haven't 
won a graded stakes since my first
victory 
a year ago..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner and entering the 
straight. The leader is still hanging on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
! The frontrunner's pace isn't dropping
at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
B-But Ikuno-san is moving up too! Look, 
she's taking the inside... and breaking 
through!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, there we go... I'm out in front! 
Now, all the way to the finish line...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is Ikuno Dictus! And coming 
from the outside, number 15, number 15 
charges in!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No...! Ikuno-san, please, hang in 
there!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A year ago,
you told me that you wanted to 
win another graded race and stand at the 
center of the Winning Live!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I can make it! Just a little more! I'll 
reach the center of a graded race!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So just for this moment! Hang in there! 
Like your life depends on itttttt!!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Not yet... NOT YET! HAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
S... she won! We did it! Ikuno-san 
wonnnnn!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I won... a graded race...! Ah,
unreal. I'm 
seriously so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... Ikuno-san, you'll get 
to see the view from the center...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. If you'd like,
please 
come to the Winning Live as well—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm planning on participating!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! A paper fan... You went out of your way 
to make this for me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though it's also to shoot footage
for 
my stream.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even so,
you put your heart into it, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Nature-san and I are gonna hype 
up the Winning Live to the max!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you enjoy being at the center
of 
a graded race to the fuuuullest♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Ikuno-san singing proudly at 
center stage! It was amazing!

Royce and Royce was in unusually high 
spirits. She was truly overjoyed by her 
friend's victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just like Ikuno-san, I want to be in the 
center of the big stage, basked in the 
spotlight and cheers.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason! I'll put my all into 
self-producing to win over core fans!"
